title: Memorial Stadium: 92,003
description: A court on the football field, a state in red, and a Guinness-scale roar—Go Deep into the night Lincoln outdrew itself.
imageHint: A sea of red under the lights for a non-football final

questions.question: On Aug. 30, 2023, which Nebraska team played before 92,003 fans—the largest women's sports crowd in U.S. history?
questions.explanation: They put a court on the football field. The Tunnel Walk still hit. For one night the Sea of Red belonged to a different kind of spike.

questions.question: That volleyball crowd of 92,003 packed which Lincoln venue—the same bowl that claims to become Nebraska's "third-largest city" on football Saturdays?
questions.explanation: Dedicated in 1923 to Nebraskans who served. Football sellouts made it famous; volleyball made it historic in a new way.

questions.question: Inside Memorial Stadium that night, Nebraska volleyball beat which in-state rival?
questions.explanation: Final: 3–0. Omaha was the perfect foil—close enough to fill carpools, big enough to feel like a statement.

questions.question: After sweeping Omaha before 92,003, which longtime Nebraska volleyball coach—already a national-title fixture—paced the sideline?
questions.explanation: Cook built a dynasty at the Devaney Center first. Putting his team on the football field was a flex felt statewide—and the crowd answered.

questions.question: Cook's volleyball night borrowed a football bowl that has sold out every home game since Nov. 3 of what year?
questions.explanation: Missouri was the opponent for sellout No. 1. By 2024 the football streak had passed 400. One court, one August night, and the Sea of Red proved it could break records for more than football.

deeperMode.title: Go Deeper: Tunnel and Stone
deeperMode.description: For anyone who has shivered through a November Tunnel Walk

questions.question: Nebraska teams take the field to which Alan Parsons Project instrumental—the heartbeat of the Tunnel Walk?
acceptedAnswers: sirius by the alan parsons project
questions.hint: Same track the Bulls made famous in Chicago

questions.question: Carved into Memorial Stadium: "Not the victory but the action; Not the goal but the game; In the deed the glory." Which Nebraska philosophy professor wrote those lines?
questions.hint: He also helped design inscriptions for the Nebraska State Capitol

easterEgg.title: Not the victory but the action
easterEgg.text: Hartley Burr Alexander's lines are carved into the stadium stone. Locals can quote them after a loss. Visitors learn them the hard way.
